meeting_point: The Headquarters: 789 W Harbor Dr  San Diego, CA 92101
description:
Experience the darker side of San Diego on this walking tour of the downtown waterfront with tales of ghostly history and haunted ships. During this walking tour, you will see several of the Embarcadero’s most popular haunted locations while learning of spooky spirits, disease, death and espionage.

With many infamous ghosts & ships there are several notable occurrences of haunting at the downtown San Diego Embarcadero along the waterfront. You will hear the thrilling stories of the spirits and have an opportunity to ghost hunt outdoors in several areas along the way.
